newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government parliamentary group asks for meeting to discuss problems and proposals. Ruling party parliamentarians say the group has not met for many months.
Police probing killing of Papua New Guinea rugby coach Joel Pera plan to visit Kandy to question Lohan Ratwatte, son of Deputy Defence Minister Anuruddha Ratwatte.
Tamil Tiger rebels resisting army offensive into their northern mainland Wanni stronghold ask for food, medicine and ammunition from leaders in east.
Army appeals for youth aged 18-26 years to enlist. Preference to be given to applicants with ability to write and speak another language and those who know how to drive or ride.
Gas shortage to continue in many parts of island till week's end because of seven day strike at Shell Gas Lanka Ltd and subsequent public holidays.
